assessment: Assignment changes and renames are associated with affected exports, but causes remain unestablished. Two counterfactual alternatives warrant bounded tests; neither has demonstrated the outcome or six-day feasibility.

openings.claim: Forbid current instructor assignment as the dependency determining course inclusion. Instead, export a center/week manifest of stable course identifiers confirmed by its coordinator, retrieving attendance independently of current instructor ownership.
openings.delta: Course inclusion depends on an explicit intended set rather than present instructor assignment or matching course names.
openings.prediction: With identical attendance and manifest, changing only current instructor assignment or course label leaves included course identifiers unchanged; coordinator confirmation may offset any checking-time savings.
openings.probe: In fabricated staging, compare incumbent and manifest exports under assignment changes, renames, and a split. Have six coordinators specify intended sets before inspecting output; measure total handling including manifest preparation. Reject on foreign-center rows or blocked attendance entry; estimate effort before implementation.
assumptions: Replacement dependencies: stable course identifiers and explicit split mappings; retrievable course/week attendance independent of current instructor; accurate coordinator manifest and usable selection interface; authenticated center-scoped retrieval; existing private hosting, nonblocking reads, and documented CSV serializer; implementation within six engineer-days and hosting allowance.

openings.claim: Forbid dependence on Sunday batch timing for file availability. Let an authorized coordinator request a center/week export when needed, using a bounded job in the existing service.
openings.delta: The coordinator controls generation timing and can regenerate directly after a correction.
openings.prediction: Direct requests shorten elapsed replacement waits if scheduling or handoff causes them; unchanged course-set errors would distinguish availability improvement from selection repair.
openings.probe: Time request, completion, download, checking, correction, and import separately in staged coordinator sessions. Compare direct generation with the incumbent path, measure ordinary attendance-write latency during concurrent requests, and verify center isolation and CSV compatibility.
assumptions: Replacement dependencies: authenticated center/week request interface; existing scoped generator; bounded concurrency and sufficient hosting headroom; private result storage and delivery; nonblocking attendance access; documented CSV output; engineering estimate within six days. Faster availability alone need not reduce active handling or improve course selection.
